fields.summary_ko.0: Lam Research (LRCX) traded at $230.10 on October 23 (+on recent close), down 46.8% from June high but up 63.7% over the past 12 months, significantly outpacing S&P 500's 15.1% gain.
fields.summary_ko.1: Currently trades at 34.1x P/E, lower than June's 74.6x but higher than September last year's 29.1x, while operating margin of 37.0% represents the highest level since 2017.
fields.summary_ko.2: Management forecasts semiconductor equipment spending will rise from mid-$150B in 2026 to over $200B in 2027, with supply chain-constrained sales deferred to be shipped in the March quarter.
